# Heart To Soul Psychotherapy

> Psychotherapy practice of Beenish Jalil, Registered Psychotherapist (Q), in Ontario, Canada. Compassionate, culturally responsive and trauma-informed therapy for adults, teens, children, couples and families, online anywhere in Ontario or in person, in English, Urdu and Hindi.

Beenish's approach is warm, collaborative and tailored to each client, drawing from CBT, DBT, mindfulness, solution-focused, somatic and strength-based approaches, and can incorporate cultural and spiritual perspectives when meaningful to the client. Areas of focus include anxiety, depression, trauma, phobias, relationship issues, grief, and growth and healing.

- Phone: 416-688-0131
- Email: s.beenishjalil@gmail.com
- Website: https://hearttosoulpsychotherapy.ca/
- Free 15-minute consultation available

## Services and fees

- [Adult/Teen Psychotherapy](https://hearttosoulpsychotherapy.ca/service/adult-teen-psychotherapy): one-on-one support for youth and adults experiencing life stressors, anxiety, depression, history of trauma or relationship issues. $80 per 50–60 minute session, online or in person.
- [Family Psychotherapy](https://hearttosoulpsychotherapy.ca/service/family-psychotherapy): sessions to improve communication, resolve conflict and strengthen relationships. $90 per 50–60 minute session, online or in person.
- [Parental Consultation](https://hearttosoulpsychotherapy.ca/service/parental-consultation): support for new and experienced parents, including pre and post partum care and parental coaching. $80 per 50–60 minute session, online or in person.
- [Community Programs](https://hearttosoulpsychotherapy.ca/service/community-programs): workshops and group sessions on self-care, emotional regulation, managing stress, and trauma and recovery.

## Practical details

- Sessions are 50 to 60 minutes; most people meet weekly or biweekly to begin with.
- Online sessions use a secure video platform and can be joined from anywhere in Ontario. In-person appointments are arranged when you speak.
- Official receipts are issued after each paid session for insurance. Many extended health plans cover psychotherapy with a Registered Psychotherapist (Q); confirm coverage with your insurer.
- Please give at least 24 hours' notice to cancel.
